headline: Manus, the AI agent startup whose acquisition by Meta was unwound, is reported to have raised about $500 million to return to China's AI agent race.
score_reason: Lowered from 5: headline only, unverified, and the raise was first headlined on 13 Oct 2026.
importance_line: Matters to China's AI agent market and to Meta's plans, but no details of investors, terms or the reason for the unwinding were read.
summary: Digitimes reports in a headline that Manus is back in China's AI agent race with a US$500 million reset after its acquisition by Meta was unwound, and a Benzinga headline of 13 Oct 2026 puts the raise at more than $500 million.
notes: Headline only; raise first headlined by Benzinga on 13 Oct 2026, so older than the 15 Oct window.
